description: Search the OceanSphere equipment library (marine engines, auxiliaries, pumps, deck machinery, navigation and electrical equipment) by model designation, equipment type or keywords; optionally filter by manufacturer, ship_area or category. Returns at most 8 models (no paging) with manufacturer, designation, category, ship area, the number of source-referenced characteristics, a model_ref and the library page URL. Models without stored values are flagged 'no stored values'. Results with stored values come first. The library identifies equipment; it is not a parts shop - OceanSphere does not list stock. Use model_ref with get_equipment_model.

category.description: Category name from list_categories, e.g. 'Radar & ECDIS'.
category.title: Category

limit.description: Maximum number of results; values above 8 are capped at 8.
limit.title: Limit

manufacturer.description: Optional manufacturer filter, e.g. 'MAN Energy Solutions'.
manufacturer.title: Manufacturer

query.description: Model designation, equipment type or keywords, e.g. 'S50ME-C' or 'fuel injection pump'.
query.title: Query

ship_area.description: Ship area slug from list_ship_areas: engine_room, deck, electrical, navigation, safety, cargo, hvac.
ship_area.title: Ship Area

name: search_equipment_models
title: Search the equipment library
